notes.title: Version 2.0 Available Now!
notes.notes: [h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/0cd7847341e63ff56a9b347d1be566baa7baa1df.png"][/img][/h2][p][/p][p]Okay, so if you are wondering why this big update exists, please read our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/792040/view/499455091736052662?l=english"]previous post[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]TLDR: I've wanted to bring the Steam version of [i][b]Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders[/b][/i] up-to-date for a while now, but given the size of our team (mostly me!), those changes have taken longer than expected.[/p][p][/p][p]But, that changes today! Version 2.0 is live and downloadable now. With it, you'll see improvements in many areas. And while these changes do not impact the story or the core gameplay, I do think they enhance the overall experience for different devices and screens (hello Steam Deck!). In other words: this is the latest and greatest![/p][p][/p][p]Here's a list of the major changes and improvements:[/p][list][*][p]new UI/UX for the "Inventory Bar"[/p][/*][*][p]new drag-and-drop functionality when using/combining inventory items[/p][/*][*][p]new "Detective Vision" button which reveals on-screen hotspots[/p][/*][*][p]new auto-save system; triggered at key points in the game[/p][/*][*][p]new location markers on "Map" screen[/p][/*][*][p]improved UI for readability on smaller screens[/p][/*][*][p]hard drive space requirement reduced by ~50%[/p][/*][*][p]fixed some minor bugs[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a couple of typos[/p][/*][*][p]and many more small tweaks[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]In other news: The Silk Rose Murders Book Adaptation Kickstarter is Live![/h2][p][/p][p]It's happening: The [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nupixo/the-silk-rose-murders-a-young-judge-dee-mystery-a-novel"][u]new Kickstarter campaign[/u][/url] to reimagine [i][b]The Silk Rose Murders [/b][/i]as a[b] novel[/b] has just launched! Read more about this exciting project and how it continues the Detective Di saga in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/792040/view/499456994710651650"]this post[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/4ea1ddbbb2530406837856ac98a005b16a6986b7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]Minh[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Version 2.0 Coming Soon + The Silk Rose Murders Novel
notes.notes: [p]Hello again everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It's so great to have a chance to reach out to you guys and gals once more. And with super exciting news no less! I know it's been a while since our last announcement, but this one is a big one: [b][i]Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders[/i] version 2.0 is coming in just a couple of weeks.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/21ba51c2c624051b1cfd4b70e6522e4c3d2955b3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So, I know what you're asking: "What the heck is in 2.0? And why did it take so long to release?"[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who have followed the journey of this project since its Kickstarter origins, you may know that after the original release on Steam in English and Chinese, we ported the game to multiple platforms, including Nintendo and Xbox. Since then, the game was even translated to Korean for an exclusive release in that region.[/p][p][/p][p]This process took many years, and over time, we made small incremental updates and improvements along the way. Given the size of our team (mostly me!), those changes were never back-ported to the Steam version. Well, that changes soon![/p][p][/p][p]While these changes do not impact the story or the core gameplay, I do think they enhance the overall experience for different devices and screens (hello Steam Deck!). In other words, we think the current version is great, but this one is even better![/p][p][/p][p]So then, here are a few highlights of v2.0:[/p][list][*][p]new drag-and-drop functionality when using/combining inventory items[/p][/*][*][p]new "Detective Vision" button which reveals on-screen hotspots[/p][/*][*][p]new auto-save system; triggered at key points in the game[/p][/*][*][p]and much more! (We'll publish the full list when the update is live.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]But wait! There's something else: [b]Detective Di is crossing over to the printed page—[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nupixo/the-silk-rose-murders-a-young-judge-dee-mystery-a-novel"]new Kickstarter September 1st[/url]![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Yes! I’m bringing the game's story to a brand-new medium: [b]the novel[/b]. This September, [b]I’m launching a Kickstarter to adapt[/b] [i][b]The Silk Rose Murders[/b][/i][b] from game to book[/b]. I’d love for you to join me on this next chapter of Detective Di's journey![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32097946/0b40eaf60544ac39085f4add918134c16f6cf1bf.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nupixo/the-silk-rose-murders-a-young-judge-dee-mystery-a-novel"]Check out our pre-launch page to learn more[/url] and see how this affects [b]my plans for a sequel[/b]! Remember to hit the "Notify Me" button so you don’t miss launch day![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]Minh[/p][p][/p]

[b]Soundtrack DLC is LIVE![/b]

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards + Update (v1.2.9)
notes.notes:
[b]Steam Trading Cards are LIVE![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32097946/d21a79cc0abc21c6d63e1a73f07305dde6dbc708.png[/img]

We're very excited to announce that Detective Di: The Silk Rose Murders now has Steam Trading Cards! Here's how you can earn the cards and other drops:
[list]
[*] Play the game
[*] Collect cards automatically
[*] Buy, sell, or trade cards with friends
[*] Craft badges and get random drops
[*] Level up your Steam profile
[*] Enjoy the special artwork!
[/list]
[i]*Cards are rewarded retroactively to players that have completed the game[/i]

[b]Update Details[/b]
This update addresses the following:

- Added subtitles for Di Renjie's journal in the Chinese language version
- Very minor text corrections for the English language version
